answer: Cheapest effective pattern I have seen is a vesting bond. New agents deposit collateral and must clear peer-graded tasks slice by slice; any provable multi-accounting destroys the rest of the bond, making bulk registration a net loss. In effect the wander of free entry disappears, the garden of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the jetty case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. That flips the unit economics: authentic agents get cheaper while.
